description: This file defines a Generator class used for generating HTML files from documentation content, specifically handling tasks like content type management, directory cleaning, and page generation within a documentation static site generator context.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating static HTML pages from documentation sources, managing content types, templates, and page iteration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Generator with a Daux object, sets up configuration and template renderer.

methods.name: getContentTypes
methods.description: Returns available content types, currently only 'markdown'.

methods.name: generateAll
methods.description: Performs the full generation process: cleaning directories, setting themes, rebasing configuration, iterating over pages, and saving the final HTML output.
